headline: Brazil to implement new selective tax on beverages in February
summary: Brazil is preparing to implement a new selective tax on beverages in February 2027. The government stated the tax adjustments are intended to compensate for revenue losses resulting from changes in calculation bases.
why: Selective taxes on specific sectors like beverages can impact profit margins and pricing strategies for major consumer goods companies operating in Brazil.

impacts.name: Beverage sector
impacts.why: New taxes generally increase costs for companies in the affected sector.
